title: Arcanea World Manifest
description: The contract every Arcanea world repo conforms to. The repo is the source of truth; the index/render/marketplace/proof layers are derived from this manifest. See docs/WORLD_REPO_STANDARD.md.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of the World Repo Standard this world targets.

id.description: Stable world id (wld_<ULID>); also the onchain identity.

laws.description: The immutable rules of the world.

cover.description: Path into media/ for the key-frame.

wallet.description: Embedded-wallet pubkey; filled invisibly at claim time. Optional.

splits.description: Basis-point splits; the sum across entries must equal 10000.

content.description: Pointers to the canonical section folders.

agents.description: The build crew — how coding agents orchestrate this world.

provenance.description: Append-only, multi-chain proof records. Excluded from contentHash computation.

snapshot.description: Permanent storage pointers — finalized PUBLIC releases only. Never for private content.

game.description: Game creation mapping layer. Seeds Higgsfield Games / Fable 5 + Higgsfield MCP for playable games with assets from the world. The 'mapper' uses memory + meaning to make games living (persistent NPC states, evolving quests).

seedPrompt.description: Rich prompt for Fable 5: full story from canon/books/characters + lore-consistent mechanics.

mechanics.description: Mapped from laws, quests, power dynamics, belief/meaning pillars (e.g. 'memory as currency', 'gate progression unlocks abilities').

proceduralMap.description: Params for procedural generation consistent with geography/history/meaning.

memoryInjection.description: Inject character evolution_state, memories, emotional anchors into game NPCs/saves for persistence across sessions.

playableUrl.description: Deployed Higgsfield game link if created.

memory.description: Persistent memory layer for the world and its inhabitants. Ties to Arcanea memory-mcp / Starlight Vaults / hybrid-memory / guardian-memory. Characters and world evolve with lived events.

vaults.description: e.g. lore, character-states, events, community-contributions, horizon-wishes

evolution.description: Append-only evolution events (character_id, delta, timestamp, meaning_impact).

persistentStates.description: Current aggregated states for characters/world (cross-session, cross-product).

meaning.description: Meaning / belief / emotional architecture layer. Maps to Seven Pillars (esp. Belief & Meaning, History as Memory). Enables coherent evolution and 'why' behind actions/lore. Used by mapper for deep game integration and Luminor-style coaching.

pillars.description: Geography, History/Time (memory), Cultures, Magic/Tech, Economy, Power/Politics, Belief/Meaning.

emotionalAnchors.description: Preserved emotional states (like Depth Scrolls) that drive character/world evolution and NPC responses in games/products.

tensions.description: Meaningful conflicts that generate story/gameplay (tradition vs progress, etc.).

community.description: Community co-creation and ownership layer. Worlds live on GitHub; contributions via PRs/forks evolve memory/meaning. Governance, reputation, shared products.

forks.description: GH fork URLs as living instances.

contributionPolicy.description: Path to CONTRIBUTING.md or rules (e.g. 'meaning-preserving PRs only; evolution logs required').

reputation.description: Skill/mastery scores, Luminor-rank for governance on this world.

events.description: Community events that write to memory/meaning (e.g. 'player choice in shared instance updated canon').

mapper.description: The superintelligence mapper: Arcanea as the intelligent translator between rich persistent worlds (memory + meaning + lore) and digital products (Higgsfield Games, books, experiences, AI agents). Versioned so agents/harnesses know how to map.
